conventions.speed_of_light: c retained; Pi_i := c p_i energy-valued conserved covector
conventions.direction: unit covariant-momentum direction in observer orthonormal triad; antipodal sign irrelevant to this even temperature map
conventions.harmonic_basis: orthonormal Condon-Shortley complex Y_lm with a_l,-m=(-1)^m conjugate(a_lm)

stored_real.order: m0, then m=1 cosine/sine, m=2 cosine/sine, ...

stf2_adapter.input_semantics: raw (a20, Re a21, Im a21, Re a22, Im a22), not stored-real c vector

physical_model.metric: ds^2=-c^2 dt^2 + a(t)^2 [exp(2 B(t))]_ij dx^i dx^j
assumptions: no perturbation, reionization, foreground, beam or polarization transfer in the geometric map
physical_model.energy: E(t)^2 = a(t)^(-2) Pi^T exp(-2 B(t)) Pi
physical_model.estimand: B_star or equivalent endpoint spatial metric, not sigma(t0)
physical_model.endpoint_history: B_star=-integral_{t_star}^{t0} sigma dt only for fixed commuting principal-axis history with Bdot=sigma and B(t0)=0; otherwise use endpoint metric/path-ordered history

small_amplitude.effective_quadrupole: Q_ij(B)=(15/(8 pi)) integral [T/Tbar-1] n_<i n_j> dOmega = B_ij+O(||B||^2)
small_amplitude.multipole_order: At order k the angular polynomial has degree <=2k; only even ell occur and generically ell=2k first appears at order B^k.

numerical_operator.matrix_exponential: For symmetric B, use eigendecomposition B=U diag(lambda) U^T and exp(-2B)=U diag(exp(-2lambda)) U^T; validate finite positive quadratic forms.
numerical_operator.direction_validation: Require finite (...,3) directions with unit norm within declared tolerance; do not silently renormalize inputs.

reference_quadrature.type: Gauss-Legendre in mu=cos(theta) x uniform azimuth

monopole_policy.anisotropy_only: subtract exact angular mean before harmonic projection and record removed mean separately
monopole_policy.forbid: do not silently set a00 to zero or mix physical monopole with harmonic replay leakage

observation_operator.covariance: C_d=R_obs C_stoch R_obs^T + N_inst + C_fg + C_sys; preserve full off-diagonal mode coupling

operator_separation.composition: Only after frame arrows, direction sign, epoch, tetrad/basis, masks and processing order are frozen.

wuo11.metric_whitening: Required in covariance-supported processed-response analysis; not exercised by unprocessed deterministic mean map.
wuo11.physical_T0_vs_a00: Typed separately; monopole/replay leakage cannot be conflated.
wuo11.ell6_source_block: Local-observer response source-block obligation, not part of intrinsic Bianchi-I mean map.
wuo11.rotation_complete_derivatives: Remain required for WU-011 local-observer processed operator.

claim_firewall: No identification of sigma(t0) without dynamical transport
No empirical anomaly, likelihood, posterior or evidence claim without source-matched observation operator and covariance
